title: A whole-town bake derives only what moved, and fits its ceiling
items: Every pull request's content build was being cut off at its 30-minute ceiling, because re-deriving all 714 web meshes took about twenty minutes before the gate even started. Now a whole-town bake derives only the meshes whose master actually changed: on today's tree a full rebuild of 712 masters moved none of them, so derivation fell from about twenty minutes to 42 seconds.
Nothing is skipped that could have changed: the record of which master each shipped mesh came from decides, the same record the gate checks, and BAKE_DERIVE_ALL=1 still derives every mesh.
